tools.name: bake
tools.description: Bake mesh maps (ambient occlusion, curvature, thickness, …) for generators and smart materials. Rays run on the GPU when there is one (`cpu: true` forces the CPU); per-map ray settings are `bake.settings` parameters (command_run).

cpu.description: Cast the rays on the CPU even when a GPU is available.

maps.description: Mesh map ids, e.g. ["ambientOcclusion", "curvature"] (default: the set's bake settings).

ts.description: Texture set index or "all" (default: the active one).

tools.name: bake_mesh_add
tools.description: Add a high-definition mesh for baking (path relative to the read root), or with `cage: true` set the bake cage. Files next to a .gltf or USD layer (buffers, base color textures) come along. Returns {name, meshes}; bake with `bake`.

cage.description: Set the bake cage (a mesh with the low poly's triangles) instead of adding a high poly.

path.description:
High-definition mesh file relative to the read root (any format `mesh_import` reads; base
color textures feed the color map).

tools.name: command_batch
tools.description: Run several commands in order: steps [{id, params}]. Stops at the first error. Returns {completed, results, failed: {index, id, error} | null}; a failed batch is a tool error.

params.description: Command parameters (see the command's `params` doc). Omitted = defaults; never a dialog.

steps.description: Commands run in order; the batch stops at the first error and reports its index.

tools.name: command_list
tools.description: List engine commands: id, label, menu path, shortcut, params doc and whether it can run now.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run an engine command by id with JSON params (see command_list). Runs with defaults, never opens a dialog. Commands given host paths (file.open, file.save, resource.import, material.save, …) are disabled: use the workspace tools (project_open, project_save, mesh_import, mesh_reimport, mesh_export, bake_mesh_add, resource_import, material_save, material_load, textures_export).

params.description: Command parameters (see the command's `params` doc). Omitted = defaults; never a dialog.

tools.name: material_load
tools.description: Add a smart material from a .tcmat file (relative to the read root) above the selection. Returns its layer.

path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the read root.

tools.name: material_save
tools.description: Save a layer or folder (default: the selected one) as a smart material file (.tcmat) below the write root.

layer.description: Layer or folder id (default: the selected layer).

path.description: `.tcmat` file relative to the write root (the extension is appended if missing).

tools.name: mesh_export
tools.description: Export the mesh with its textures (obj, glb, usda, usdc or usdz; path relative to the write root). Returns {path, textures?}.

format.description:
obj (MTL and textures written next to it), glb (textures embedded), usda, usdc (textures
written next to it) or usdz (textures packaged); default: from the extension, else obj.

path.description: Output file relative to the write root; the format's extension is appended if missing.

tools.name: mesh_import
tools.description: New project from a mesh file (path relative to the read root): one texture set per material. Returns the session; import warnings are in the session log.

path.description:
Mesh file relative to the read root: .glb, .gltf (with its .bin files and images beside it), .fbx, .dae, .usd, .usda, .usdc,
.usdz, .abc, .obj, .ply, .stl.

tools.name: mesh_reimport
tools.description: Reimport the project's mesh from a file (path relative to the read root) or, without a path, from the project's own copy. Texture sets map by material index; `preserveStrokes` re-projects painted pixels where the UVs changed. Returns {preserved?}.

path.description: Mesh file relative to the read root; omit to re-read the project's own copy.

preserveStrokes.description: Painted pixels follow the surface where the new mesh's UVs changed.

tools.name: paint_stroke
tools.description: Paint a stroke with the paint tool on the selected layer (or its mask target): sets the brush material (color, roughness, metallic, height) and size/hardness, then strokes through `points` in viewport pixels. See viewport_render for where the mesh is.

color.description: Base color: `[r, g, b]` linear 0..1 or `"#rrggbb"`.

points.description: Stroke points `[[x, y], …]` in viewport pixels (origin top-left), as in `viewport_render`.

size.description: Brush size 0..100 (percent of the largest brush).

viewport.description: Viewport size `[w, h]` the points refer to (default: the session viewport, 1280×800).

tools.name: project_new
tools.description: Start a new project on a built-in mesh (one texture set per material, each with an empty paint layer). Returns the session.

mesh.description: Built-in mesh: material_ball (default), sphere, cube, rounded_cube, cylinder, torus, plane, crate.

resolution.description: Texture set resolution, a power of two from 128 to 8192 (default 1024).

template.description:
Project template (channels, normal format, resolution, shader): a name from the
`project.templates` command, e.g. "PBR - Metallic Roughness" (default) or "PBR - Specular Glossiness".

tools.name: project_open
tools.description: Open a .tcraft project or a mesh file (path relative to the read root). Returns the session.

path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the read root.

tools.name: project_save
tools.description: Save the project as .tcraft (path relative to the write root; omit to save to its own file).

path.description:
Forward-slash path relative to the write root (`.tcraft` is appended if missing). Omit to
save to the project's own file.

tools.name: resource_import
tools.description: Import an image (png, jpg, tga, tif, bmp, webp, exr, hdr; path relative to the read root) as a project resource. Returns its name, for command_run layer.add.image {name} or tool.stencil {image}.

path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the read root.

tools.name: session_inspect
tools.description: The whole session as JSON: project, mesh, texture sets (resolution, channels, baked maps), the layer stack top to bottom (fill sources, masks, effects, painted tile counts), tool, camera, display and history.

tools.name: textures_export
tools.description: Export textures with a preset into a folder relative to the write root. Returns the written files and warnings.

dir.description: Output folder relative to the write root (created if missing; `.` = the root).

format.description: File format override: png, jpg, tga, tif, exr, …

preset.description: Preset name from `command_run export.presets`, e.g. "glTF PBR Metal Roughness".

size.description: Output size in pixels (power of two).

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: Bridge mode: the app's UI state (panels, windows, mode, layout, viewport rect, toasts).

tools.name: ui_menu_invoke
tools.description: Bridge mode: activate a menu item by id like a click (may open a window). ui.menu.list lists ids.

id.description: Menu item id from the app's `ui.menu.list`, e.g. `file.save`, `viewport.frame`.

tools.name: ui_screenshot
tools.description: Bridge mode: PNG of the whole app window (downscaled to 2048 px a side at most).

tools.name: viewport_render
tools.description: Headless: render the 3D view (or the 2D UV view) as a PNG image, up to 2048 px a side. Camera yaw/pitch apply to this render only. In bridge mode use viewport_screenshot.

cpu.description: Path trace on the CPU even when a GPU is available.

pitch.description: Camera pitch in degrees (-89..89) for this render only.

samples.description:
Path trace the 3D view with this many samples per pixel (1..4096) instead of the
real-time viewport: slower, physically based light transport; on the GPU when it has
compute shaders, otherwise on the CPU (no GPU needed).

view.description: `3d` (default) or `2d` (the UV view of the active texture set).

width.description: Pixels, 16..2048 (default: the session viewport, the space `paint_stroke` points use).

yaw.description: Camera yaw in degrees for this render only.

tools.name: viewport_screenshot
tools.description: Bridge mode: PNG of the live app's 3D or 2D viewport.
